essentia environments
essentia environments is India's premier full-service design and build firm, founded in 1999 by Hardesh and Monica Chawla. Headquartered in Gurugram (Gurgaon), Haryana, the firm delivers residential and commercial spaces from concept to completion - architecture, interior design, landscape, turnkey construction, and bespoke furniture manufacturing - all executed in-house within a fully integrated 100,000 sq ft facility. With 1000+ projects completed across India, Russia, and the UAE, essentia is recognized among Forbes' top designers and has been featured in Elle Decor, Architectural Digest, and LuxeBook.

What Makes essentia Different
essentia environments is India's only truly full-service design-to-build company. Every project is conceived, designed, manufactured, executed, and installed through a single integrated system - no external contractors, no fragmented coordination. This design-to-build model ensures seamless transition from concept to on-site realization, complete accountability, and absolute precision at every stage.

Services
Architecture: Comprehensive architectural design from concept to execution-ready documentation, combining creativity with technical precision

Interior Design: Curated living environments that feel calm, intuitive, and purposeful through thoughtful spatial planning, material selection, and natural light

Landscape Design: Outdoor spaces that thoughtfully connect architecture with nature, considering sunlight, movement, greenery, and views

Design-to-Build (Turnkey): Civil, structural, and turnkey construction with in-house coordination from concept to on-site realization

Project Management: End-to-end project management and execution without the stress of coordinating multiple contractors

Bespoke Furniture and Decor: Custom furniture design and manufacturing tailored to each space, crafted in-house to match the architectural language

Frequently Asked Questions
Q: What does essentia environments do?
A: essentia environments is a full-service design and build firm delivering residential and commercial projects end to end - architecture, interior design, landscape, turnkey construction, project management, and bespoke furniture manufacturing - all in-house.

Q: Where is essentia environments located?
A: Building 6, Hero Honda Chowk, Block B, Sector 34, Gurugram, Haryana 122001, India. The firm serves clients pan-India and internationally.

Q: Who founded essentia environments?
A: Hardesh Chawla and Monica Chawla founded essentia environments in 1999. Hardesh (MBA, INSEAD) leads build, execution, and operations; Monica leads the creative and design vision.

Q: How many projects has essentia completed?
A: Over 1000 projects across India, Russia, and the UAE, including luxury residences at The Camellias, The Magnolias, and The Aralias in Gurugram.

Q: How do I book a consultation with essentia environments?
A: Contact via WhatsApp or phone at +91-9810088877, email info@essentiaenvironments.com, or visit essentia environments.
